JP.name: Temporary visitor visa (single entry)
JP.feeBasis: About ¥15,000 for a single-entry visa from July 1, 2026, collected in local currency (¥3,000 until then).
JP.daysBasis: Normally five working days from the embassy's acceptance; longer where the case is referred to Tokyo.

sources.what: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan: visa fees from July 1, 2026, about ¥15,000 single entry
Embassy of Japan in Singapore: a visa can normally be issued in five working days

IN.name: e-Tourist Visa (30 days)
IN.feeBasis: The 30-day e-Tourist Visa from July to March ($10 from April to June).
IN.daysBasis: Applied for online at least four days before arrival.
IN.stayBasis: The e-Tourist Visa charged allows 30 days.

sources.what: High Commission of India in Singapore, e-Tourist Visa: apply at least four days ahead; 30-day eTV US$25 July to March, US$10 April to June

KR.name: Short-term visitor visa (C-3, single entry)
KR.feeBasis: A single-entry visa for 90 days or less; fees differ by nationality and post.
KR.daysBasis: Seven calendar days at the consulate in Dubai; at least ten to fifteen working days at Los Angeles.
KR.stayBasis: A single-entry visa for 90 days or less.

sources.what: Embassy of Korea in the US, visa fees: single entry, 90 days or less, USD 40
Consulate General of Korea in Dubai: visa processing takes 7 calendar days
Consulate General of Korea in Los Angeles: at least 10 to 15 business days

VN.name: E-visa (single entry)
VN.feeBasis: The single-entry e-visa ($50 for multiple entries), not refunded if refused.

sources.what: Vietnam Economic Times (Ministry of Planning and Investment), Vietnam's e-visa: $25 single entry, $50 multiple, up to 90 days
Issa Compass, Vietnam tourist e-visa 2026: about three working days

TH.name: Tourist visa (single entry)
TH.feeBasis: A single-entry tourist visa at the Royal Thai Embassies in Washington and Ho Chi Minh City; other posts charge their own currency.
TH.daysBasis: Five working days at Ho Chi Minh City; up to fifteen business days at Washington.
TH.stayBasis: A single-entry visitor may stay up to 60 days from entry.

sources.what: Royal Thai Embassy, Washington: single entry USD 40, up to 15 business days
Royal Thai Consulate-General, Ho Chi Minh City: USD 40, five working days
Royal Thai Consulate-General, Los Angeles: up to 60 days from entry
